release_notes: Replaced the old combat/reward cadence with continuous three-ball pinball, charged plunger, two responsive flippers, savers, kickbacks, ball grades, live Moon Mart purchases, collection, travel, and bonus fields.
Added distinct Verdant and Ember collision graphs, orbit rules, launch curves, device economies, a rotating Verdant Bloom Carousel, and Ember’s moving Rune Shuttle.

Implemented Hunt, Hatch, Transmute, and Journey as multi-phase physical modes: capture seal, cracking egg and moving newborn, creature-selected directional runes plus relocating relics, and portal plus destination beacon.
Added separate Constellation and Guardian bonus arenas. The Guardian has three movement phases and two stages of closing physical barriers.
Completion effects now briefly lock the table, preserving ball position, saver time, mode time, and input state instead of obscuring live danger.

Generated three original painted playfield underlays using the imagegen skill’s built-in mode. The prompts emphasized dense handheld pinball readability while excluding licensed characters, logos, and copied table art. Provenance is recorded in [ASSET_SOURCES.md](/home/waynechi/dev/async-gamedev/game/assets/model_generated/ASSET_SOURCES.md).

Core implementation is in [game_logic.gd](/home/waynechi/dev/async-gamedev/game/src/game_logic.gd) and [main.gd](/home/waynechi/dev/async-gamedev/game/src/main.gd). The measurable rubric is in [POKEMON_PINBALL_SIMILARITY_RUBRIC.md](/home/waynechi/dev/async-gamedev/docs/POKEMON_PINBALL_SIMILARITY_RUBRIC.md).

Validation passed: `npm test`, Godot logic tests, full main-scene physical tests, web export, `git diff --check`, and browser smoke covering WebGL2, recording, telemetry, both flippers, charged launch, and natural table contact. The browser recording contained 42,457 bytes. Similarity gate: 9.56/10, three accepting reviewers, zero P0 issues.
